name: neighbourhood
description: NeighbourHood — neighbours donating and lending useful items.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @neighbourhood/shared" "npm run dev -w @neighbourhood/api" "npm run dev -w @neighbourhood/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @neighbourhood/api && npm run build -w @neighbourhood/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:db: npm run build:shared && npm run test:db -w @neighbourhood/api
